description: This file defines an Android activity demonstrating the use of a custom ActionProvider, including an inner class that provides a menu item action for launching system settings.

classes.name: ActionBarSettingsActionProviderActivity
classes.description: An Android activity demonstrating how to add a custom ActionProvider to the Action Bar for launching system settings.

classes.name: SettingsActionProvider
classes.description: An ActionProvider subclass that creates an action view with a button to start the system Settings activity.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the menu resource for the activity's options menu.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selection in the activity, providing a default toast message.

methods.name: SettingsActionProvider<init>
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ActionProvider with context.

methods.name: onCreateActionView
methods.description: Creates and returns the custom action view with a button that launches system settings when clicked.

methods.name: onPerformDefaultAction
methods.description: Defines the default action for the provider, which launches system settings.
